probe.title: About Everyday^
probe.text_sample: About Everyday^ Air OS Get early access Get early access Clean energy. Better living. Starting at home. Clean energy. Better living. Starting at home. A new company for the new home. We are building something that sits quietly at the centre of everyday life. It brings together what matters most. Air. Water. Energy. Reimagined as a new kind of integrated, intelligent infrastructure, designed to work naturally in the home. The systems we rely on were built for another time. They shape how we live, what we spend, and the impact we leave behind, yet they’ve barely changed. Expensive and out of step with how we live today. While attention moves elsewhere, the pressure at home keeps building. This is where change matters most, and what we set out to address across three challenges. 1 Cost of living. Make living at home far more affordable. 2 Climate crisis. Reduce the home's impact on the planet. 3 Quality of life. Raise the standard for health and comfort at home. 1 Cost of living.
